issue.title: Bump sase-core-rs floor once a release ships the imported_source_owner scan-wire field
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-w2.8 (epic sase-w2, imported-family-ui) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1; partially resolved by sase-w2.land on 2026-09-04, remainder gated on the next sase-core release.

sase-w2.land bumped the declared floor 0.32.16 -> 0.32.19, which covers every published binding (typed owner identity in v0.32.17/18, archive validation in v0.32.19) and returns tools/probe_core_floor to clean. Still outstanding: sase-core commit cb2362c ("feat(agent): persist imported_source_owner through scan wire", on origin/master after v0.32.19) is in no published release. A published-wheel install therefore omits imported_source_owner from AgentMetaWire/DoneMarker wire records; ACE's wire enrichment path (src/sase/ace/tui/models/_loaders/_meta_enrichment_wire.py) then applies None while the filesystem enrichment path supplies the value, so owner badges become path-dependent on published wheels. Dev/CI installs build from the checkout and are unaffected.

Remediation: after the next sase-core release (>= the release containing cb2362c) publishes, bump the pyproject.toml sase-core-rs floor to it. Note tools/probe_core_floor cannot flag this itself — it probes binding names, not wire fields (the sase-km blind spot).

task_type_fields.impact: Owner badges for imported agents are enrichment-path-dependent on published-wheel installs; dev/CI installs building sase-core from checkout are unaffected
task_type_fields.location: pyproject.toml sase-core-rs constraint; sase-core cb2362c crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/wire.rs
task_type_fields.repro: Install published sase-core-rs 0.32.19 (latest) and live-scan an imported agent: AgentMetaWire.imported_source_owner arrives None on the wire enrichment path while the filesystem path supplies it; tools/probe_core_floor stays green because it probes binding names, not wire fields

payload.description: sase-km documented the core-floor blind spot this task instantiates: floor gates probe binding names, so a wire-field addition (imported_source_owner) ships invisible to the probe

payload.entry: Release progress observed by sase-w2.land on 2026-09-04: sase-core v0.32.20 (commit 0b5049f) is tagged and contains cb2362c, but the sase-core-rs 0.32.20 wheel is not on PyPI yet (latest published: 0.32.19). Bump the floor as soon as the wheel publishes; the probe's scratch install will fail if bumped before then.
